notes: Three-wheel front-load cargo trike. Maker specs are in collapsed accordions (Technical Specifications, Measurements & Weights) that had to be opened. Regular price depends on color ($6,499-$6,799); all on sale at $5,499 (Black Friday). Only independent source found (Electric Bike Report, 2024 'The Original') predates the 4+ upgrade (new 614 Wh battery, torque sensor, UL certification, heavier at 168 lbs), so only unchanged specs (motor, 20 mph Class 2) are counted from it.
